model.title: No Bonuses for Bad Service Act
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee · Sen. Josh Hawley (R-MO)

summary.text: The bill would prevent the Postmaster General and Deputy Postmaster General from receiving bonuses in any fiscal year when the Postal Service fails to meet its on-time mail delivery targets.
